capture_source: live capture 2026-06-29 via Wireshark; SAP A4H gateway 192.168.88.7:3300 reply on the registered server channel (this capture is a logon-error reply: the post-registration client logon used a wrong password)
notes: GW frame type 0x06CB, RFC marker 0x00000001 (server direction). TLV stream ends with 0x0402 'Name or password is incorrect (repeat logon)' + 0xFFFF terminator.
Observed tags (cross-ref the logon-TLV table): 0x0108, 0x013b, 0x0450 ('A4H' sys id), 0x0016/0x0017 host blocks, 0x0013 '793', 0x0012 '758', 0x0601/0x0130 'SAPMSSY1', 0x0500 call-end, 0x0402 error.
0x0402-carries-error / absent-on-success holds for the server direction (mirrors session.py).
Stored as a reference fixture for the Wave 2 accepted-response serializer (response-only tag set OQ-3/A4); not byte-reproduced by this plan, so all content is marked variable.
Credentials scrubbed: this reply carries no plaintext credentials (logon failed); never log inbound user/passwd (threat T-05-S03).
